# Toast (`toast`)

Transient message with variants, an action and a queue.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createToaster` (types in `dist/web/overlays/toast.d.ts`): `.mh-toaster` (`--top | --top-end | --bottom | --bottom-end`): a polite live region that shows `.mh-toast` messages (`--neutral | --info | --success | --warning | --danger`), up to `max` at a time with the rest queued. Toasts dismiss themselves after `duration`; hovering or focusing one pauses its timer, Escape inside closes it. Danger toasts are `role="alert"`.

```ts
export function createToaster(options: ToasterOptions = {}): Toaster;

export interface ToasterOptions {
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default `document.body`). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  /** Default `bottom`. */
  placement?: ToasterPlacement;
  /** How many show at once; the rest wait in a queue. 1 shows one at a time. Default 3. */
  max?: number;
  /** Default time on screen in ms. Default 5000 (8000 with an action). */
  duration?: number;
  /** Accessible name of the region. Default "Notifications". */
  label?: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createToaster } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const toaster = createToaster({ placement: 'bottom' });

const save = createButton({
  label: 'Save settings',
  icon: 'check',
  onClick: () => {
    toaster.show({
      tone: 'success',
      message: 'Settings saved',
      action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: () => toaster.show('Changes undone') },
    });
  },
});

document.body.append(save.el);
```

## React API

`Button` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createButton`.

```ts
export function Button({ variant, size, icon, trailingIcon, loading = false, fullWidth, disabled, className, type = 'button', children, ...rest }: ButtonProps);

export interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`useToaster` (types in `dist/react/overlays.d.ts`): A toaster owned by this component: created on the first `show`, removed on unmount. The returned object isstable. (For one app-wide toaster, `toast()` needs no hook.)

```ts
export function useToaster(options: ToasterOptions = {}): ToasterApi;
```

## React example

```tsx
import { Button, useToaster } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ToastExample() {
  const toaster = useToaster({ placement: 'bottom' });
  const save = () => {
    toaster.show({
      tone: 'success',
      message: 'Settings saved',
      action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: () => toaster.show('Changes undone') },
    });
  };
  return (
    <Button icon="check" onClick={save}>
      Save settings
    </Button>
  );
}
```
